snippet.title: We The Pixies - Alpha Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Update: Alpha is now live as of 11/29/2020!
http://www.wethepixies.net/

We've got some pretty flaptastic stuff coming soon - fly on over our Discord to be the first to know when we release this update! https://discord.gg/c23JsZf

Special thanks to June for composing the original music in the background! You can hear more of her flitterific work here: https://bit.ly/39cMt3x

Find links to our official social media accounts and other We The Pixies information here:
https://linktr.ee/WeThePixies
